Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl1: Heat builds while the Sandevistan runs and drains once it is off. Switch it off before the top of the bar to avoid a thermal cutoff.
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl2: From 60%% of your Heat ceiling the screen edges glow red. At the ceiling (100 unless thermally scarred) the implant cuts out by itself: 1 s stagger, rejection +2 to +4 (less with adaptation, none at stable) and locked until it cools.
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl3: Warning beeps have started. Cut it manually now: a manual cutoff is free, a thermal cutoff staggers you and adds rejection (less the more adapted you are).
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl4: The implant is about to shut itself down. If you armed the override (hold Z) you will enter Overdrive instead of cutting out.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl1: The Sandevistan is cooling after a thermal cutoff, emergency stop or Overdrive. It cannot be activated until Heat is 0.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl2: The Sandevistan is cooling after a thermal cutoff, emergency stop or Overdrive. It cannot be activated until Heat is 0.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl3: The Sandevistan is cooling after a thermal cutoff, emergency stop or Overdrive. It cannot be activated until Heat is 0.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl4: The Sandevistan is cooling after a thermal cutoff, emergency stop or Overdrive. It cannot be activated until Heat is 0.
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv: A stiff, sore back: an early warning. Rejection climbs until adaptation is stable (lab 5, military 7) unless immunosuppressants cover you.
Fever (from 37.8) and constant lumbar pain. Passive adaptation XP stops. Immunosuppressants halt the climb; sleeping halves it.
Spasms and blurred vision. The Sandevistan cannot be activated while rejection is 75 or higher. Take an immunosuppressant.
Neurogenic shock: you keep losing health and wake up if asleep. At 100 the implant is expelled with massive bleeding and destroyed.
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l: Neural load is building up, still without symptoms. After 2 hours without using the implant it decays 0.5 per hour. Adaptation lowers the load each use adds (up to -25%%).
Risk zone: Heat builds 10%% faster and rest only lowers the load 0.25 per hour. Immunosuppressants and antidepressants speed it up.
Critical zone: screen glitches, nosebleeds, Heat +20%% and chronic rejection. From 60 whispers, distant footsteps and night terrors begin.
At 80 cyberpsychosis sets in and the screaming starts. Stop using the implant; rest and treatment lower the load.
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de: Neural load never drops below 50 and rises twice as fast while the implant is on. The only way out: 5 days without any implant. Under 60 the hallucinations stay quiet.
You hear things that are not there: footsteps, whispers, bangs. The dilation stutters. Neural load rises twice as fast with the implant on.
Sudden screams (up to once an hour) draw zombies from 25 tiles. Cybernetic fury: more melee damage and speed, no panic. Overdrive risks a deep chest cut.
Blackouts, tunnel vision and reflex misfires: the implant may fire by itself. Each Overdrive risks a deep chest cut (20%%) and death (1%%).
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl: Herbal immunosuppressants are building up. Each dose adds 25 and it falls 2.5 per hour.
Nausea grows with the level. Avoid another herbal dose until it drops below 25.
Strong nausea. Switch to another immunosuppressant or wait: more herbs make it worse.
Critical poisoning with heavy nausea. It only falls 2.5 per hour. No more herbal doses.
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv: The homemade Kerenzikov crash is almost over. Fatigue and breathlessness are fading.
Heavy limbs and a foggy head: fatigue rises and stamina is capped. It wears off with time.
You can barely keep your eyes open. Fatigue rises and stamina stays capped until the crash ends (2 in-game hours in total).
The crash has just started: high fatigue and stamina capped at the first exertion level for up to 2 in-game hours. Rest.
Moodles_SandevistanDestroyed_Bad_desc_lv: The Sandevistan burned out from rejection. It has to be surgically removed (First Aid 7) before a new one can be installed.
The Sandevistan burned out from rejection. It has to be surgically removed (First Aid 7) before a new one can be installed.
The Sandevistan burned out from rejection. It has to be surgically removed (First Aid 7) before a new one can be installed.
The Sandevistan burned out from rejection. It has to be surgically removed (First Aid 7) before a new one can be installed.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl1: Zombies move at 0.30x. You run 25%% and attack 50%% faster, with +15%% melee damage. The longer it stays on, the more momentum.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl2: Zombies at 0.25x. You run 35%% and attack 75%% faster, +15%% melee damage. Momentum adds up to +10%% running, +25%% attack speed.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl3: Zombies at 0.20x. You run 40%% and attack 100%% faster, +15%% melee damage. Momentum adds up to +10%% running, +25%% attack speed.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl4: Peak power: zombies slowed to half their already reduced speed, +40%% running, +100%% attack speed, +50%% damage. Then the collapse: stagger and neural load and rejection spikes.
Moodles_SandevistanKerenzikov_Good_desc_: Stamina boost and regeneration, immune to light stagger; tachycardia. Lasts 30 min (military) or 10 (homemade, then a 2 h crash). While the Sandevistan is on, Heat builds 20%% slower.
Stamina boost and regeneration, immune to light stagger; tachycardia. Lasts 30 min (military) or 10 (homemade, then a 2 h crash). While the Sandevistan is on, Heat builds 20%% slower.
Stamina boost and regeneration, immune to light stagger; tachycardia. Lasts 30 min (military) or 10 (homemade, then a 2 h crash). While the Sandevistan is on, Heat builds 20%% slower.
Stamina boost and regeneration, immune to light stagger; tachycardia. Lasts 30 min (military) or 10 (homemade, then a 2 h crash). While the Sandevistan is on, Heat builds 20%% slower.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv: Under 12 hours of coverage left. Rejection is held back, neural load decays twice as fast and each use adds less load. Take another dose before it runs out.
12 to 36 hours left. Clinical and homemade doses stop rejection, herbal ones cut it to a quarter. Neural load decays twice as fast.
36 to 60 hours of coverage. Rejection is held back and neural load decays twice as fast.
More than 60 hours of coverage (cap 72). Rejection is held back and neural load decays twice as fast.
Moodles_SandevistanAntidep_Good_desc_lvl: Neural load decays 1.5x faster; hallucinations, glitches, screams and spontaneous nosebleeds are halved. It does not cure cyberpsychosis.
Neural load decays 1.5x faster; hallucinations, glitches, screams and spontaneous nosebleeds are halved. It does not cure cyberpsychosis.
Neural load decays 1.5x faster; hallucinations, glitches, screams and spontaneous nosebleeds are halved. It does not cure cyberpsychosis.
Neural load decays 1.5x faster; hallucinations, glitches, screams and spontaneous nosebleeds are halved. It does not cure cyberpsychosis.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l: Less than a day of withdrawal left: stress and fatigue still creep up a little. Antidepressants halve it. The Implant tab shows the exact time.
Your brain misses the speed: stress and fatigue creep up for the first two days after losing the implant (more than a day left). Antidepressants halve it.
Your brain misses the speed: stress and fatigue creep up for the first two days after losing the implant (more than a day left). Antidepressants halve it.
Your brain misses the speed: stress and fatigue creep up for the first two days after losing the implant (more than a day left). Antidepressants halve it.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv: The withdrawal is over. Between 2 and 3 days left without any implant until the cyberpsychosis fades. Installing one restarts the count.
Between 1 and 2 days left without any implant until the cyberpsychosis fades. Installing one restarts the count.
Less than a day left (12 to 24 hours) until the cyberpsychosis fades. Installing an implant restarts the count.
Under 12 hours left until the cyberpsychosis fades. Do not install an implant now: it restarts the count.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv: Immunosuppressants lowered your defenses. Wounds get infected a little more and heal a little slower.
Disinfect and cleanly bandage every wound. Colds and spoiled food hit harder.
A dirty wound gets infected easily and takes long to close. Stay warm, eat well and avoid corpses.
Your immune system is almost shut down. Any open wound is a serious risk; antibiotics help.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des: The implant is recalibrating after a firmware change: Heat rises 10%% faster until the hour is up. The Implant tab shows the time left.
The implant is recalibrating after a firmware change: Heat rises 10%% faster until the hour is up. The Implant tab shows the time left.
The implant is recalibrating after a firmware change: Heat rises 10%% faster until the hour is up. The Implant tab shows the time left.
The implant is recalibrating after a firmware change: Heat rises 10%% faster until the hour is up. The Implant tab shows the time left.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl: You have spent 25%% of the stamina you had but it is not charged yet. It is all taken when the implant goes off; while it is on, natural regeneration pays part of it back.
Half of what you had at activation is already owed. Watch it: with the debt near the top, turning off leaves you out of breath.
Three quarters owed. The next Overdrive will not cover it: cut now while you still have some air to pay with.
The debt already equals what you had at activation. Turning off now leaves you gasping: stagger and no sprint. Past 35%% more, the implant cuts out by itself.
